text: First, why there is no SDK.

text: So heeyID gives three things.

text: The REST API.

text: The OpenAPI contract that describes it.

text: And an integration guide with the rules for the app.

text: The contract describes every call: the path, the request, the answer and the errors.

text: There is one call for each step: start a registration, verify the code, set the password, log in, give consent, open a proofing session, set the app PIN and renew a session.

text: Each error has one shape: a code, a reason key, a message for the customer, and whether a retry is allowed, and after how long.

text: Each code names one outcome of the product, one to one.
